signs-modern.title: 48 Vacation Rental Signs, Modern Editable Printable Bundle, Wifi QR Code Sign, House Rules, Checkout Sign, Short Term Rental Host
signs-modern.description:
48 editable vacation rental signs in a clean, modern style. Type your details once and every sign fills in. Then print or save as PDF.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download and unzip. Open Sign_Generator.html on your computer (works offline, no account, no design app).
2. Type your property name, Wi-Fi, check-in and check-out times, quiet hours, trash days, parking, emergency info, check-out steps and local tips.
3. Tick the signs you want, edit any wording, choose US Letter or A4 and 1 or 2 signs per page.
4. Print, or save a PDF for the copy shop.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Sign generator with 48 editable signs, including 3 blank custom signs
- Wi-Fi QR code: guests scan to join your network
- Optional second QR code for your digital guidebook link
- 6 color choices, an ink-saver option and an 8×10 in frame-size option with cut lines
- Ready-to-print write-in PDFs (Letter and A4) if you'd rather fill in by hand
- Step-by-step instructions

SIGNS
Welcome, Wi-Fi, house rules, arrival info, check-out, no smoking, quiet hours, trash, recycling, parking, pool rules, hot tub, thermostat, air conditioning, TV & remote, kitchen, coffee, dishwasher, washer & dryer, fireplace, remove shoes, pet rules, pet free, guest book, leave a review, emergency, local favorites, lockbox & door code, bathroom, towels, bed linens, BBQ grill, beach gear, hiking tips, lost keys, garbage disposal, don't flush, no parties, security notice, save energy, lock up, safety equipment, deck & balcony, outdoor shower, note from the host and 3 custom signs.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Digital download. Nothing is shipped.
- Use the generator on a Windows or Mac computer in Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox. Phones and tablets are not recommended for editing.
- Your details are saved in your browser on that computer.
- For use at your own rental properties. Please don't share or resell the files.
- Want the full set? The Host Starter Bundle includes both sign styles, a mobile guest guidebook and check-out cards.

Made with care by Handy Helper Studio. AI tools helped write the sign text and code, and every file was checked and tested by hand.
Not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by any vacation rental or booking platform. Brand names are not used in these files.

host-bundle.title: Vacation Rental Host Bundle, Digital Guest Guidebook QR Code, 48 Editable Signs in 2 Styles, Checkout Card, Short Term Rental Welcome Kit
host-bundle.description:
Everything a vacation rental host needs to welcome guests, in one download: a mobile guest guidebook with a QR code, 48 editable printable signs in 2 styles (Modern + Rustic), and check-out cards.

WHAT'S INSIDE
1. Guest guidebook: 8 property-type templates (beach house, mountain cabin, A-frame, lake house, villa, bungalow, city apartment, farmhouse). Edit everything in a free Google Sheet. Guests scan one QR code and the guide opens on their phone, in 12 languages. Setup guide PDF for each type.
2. Vacation Rental Signs – Modern: sign generator with 48 editable signs, Wi-Fi QR code, Letter or A4, 1 or 2 per page, plus write-in PDFs.
3. Vacation Rental Signs – Rustic: the same 48 signs in a nature style.
4. Check-out cards: printable checklist cards, 4 per page, in both styles, Letter and A4.
Plus a start-here guide with every link.

HOW IT WORKS
- Guidebook: open the template link, click Make a copy, fill in your details, then follow your setup page to get the guest link and QR code (about 15 minutes).
- Signs: open the sign generator on your computer, type your details once and all 48 signs fill in. Paste your guidebook link to add its QR code to the Welcome sign.
- Cards: print, fill in and cut.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Digital download. Nothing is shipped.
- A free Google account is needed for the guidebook. The signs and cards work offline with no account.
- Edit the signs on a Windows or Mac computer.
- No monthly fees.
- For use at your own rental properties. Please don't share or resell the files.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: an Excel .xlsx file plus a PDF guide that shows how to open it in Excel or import it into Google Sheets.

• Rent ledger with automatic status: Paid, Paid late, Partial, Late, Due, Upcoming, plus balance, days late and your late fee
• Lease end alerts: leases ending soon turn orange, expired leases turn red (you set the alert window)
• Expenses mapped to common Schedule E-style categories, per property, with shared bills split evenly

smart-planner.title: ADHD Cleaning Planner Google Sheets, Smart Cleaning Schedule Spreadsheet, Picks Today's Tasks by Energy, Chore Tracker Excel, Streak
smart-planner.description:
A cleaning planner that does the choosing for you. List your rooms and tasks once, pick today's energy (Low, Medium or High), and the Today tab shows a short list of what's due, most overdue first. No more staring at a huge list.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: a PDF with your Google Sheets copy link and setup steps, plus the Excel file. Setup takes about 10 minutes.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT IT DOES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Today tab: only the few tasks that are due (you choose 1 to 10, default 5), filtered by your energy
• Frequencies: daily, every N days, weekly, monthly, seasonal
• Energy levels on every task: Low, Medium, High
• Done Log: pick the task from a dropdown, add the date. Today turns ☑ and the progress bar fills
• Today's list stays put all day, so nothing jumps around
• 15-minute Quick Reset list with a running total of minutes (checkboxes in Google Sheets, TRUE/FALSE in Excel)
• Weekly view: focus zone, tasks due and tasks done for each day
• Progress: streak, best streak, last 14 days, tasks and minutes in the last 30 days
• Room / zone rotation by day or by week, with a gentle priority boost
• Example data included so you can see how it works
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT YOU GET
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Google Sheets template (copy link in the PDF)
• Excel file (.xlsx), no macros
• Start Here PDF guide
• 9 tabs: Today, Quick Reset, Weekly View, Progress, Start Here, Settings, Zones, Tasks, Done Log
